Since \(84\) is the least common multiple, \(\operatorname{lcm}(x,6,4)=84\).  
With \(\operatorname{lcm}(4,6)=12\), we need \(\operatorname{lcm}(x,12)=84\).  
Thus \(x\) must be a divisor of \(84\) that includes the factor \(7\):  
\[
x\in\{7,14,21,28,42,84\}.
\]
The least possible first number of rows is \(7\).

\boxed{7}
